text: You see a water processing control computer. It has# malfunctioned due to the removal of a critical piece# of hardware.
source_text:
You see a water processing control computer. It has
# malfunctioned due to the removal of a critical piece
# of hardware.

text: 你看到一个控水计算机。它因为一个主要硬件被取出而产了生故障。
source_text: 你看到一个控水计算机。它因为一个主要硬件被取出而产了生故障。

text: Your search the water processing control computer is successful.# You find the water chip without a problem.
source_text:
Your search the water processing control computer is successful.
# You find the water chip without a problem.

text: 你成功的搜索了控水计算机，顺利地找到了净水芯片。
source_text: 你成功的搜索了控水计算机，顺利地找到了净水芯片。

text: You search the water computer. It takes a while but you# eventually discover the water chip.
source_text:
You search the water computer. It takes a while but you
# eventually discover the water chip.

text: 虽然花了不少时间，但你还是找到了净水芯片。
source_text: 虽然花了不少时间，但你还是找到了净水芯片。

text: The computer cannot be repaired without a functional water# chip.
source_text:
The computer cannot be repaired without a functional water
# chip.

text: 没有净水芯片所以不能修理计算机。
source_text: 没有净水芯片所以不能修理计算机。

text: You easily remove the water chip from the computer. You hear# the flow of water to the city stop.
source_text:
You easily remove the water chip from the computer. You hear
# the flow of water to the city stop.

text: 你轻易的从电脑上拔下了净水芯片。城市的供水似乎停止了。
source_text: 你轻易的从电脑上拔下了净水芯片。城市的供水似乎停止了。

text: You struggle with the computer for a while, but you cannot# remove the chip. After a moment, you realize you forgot to remove# the locking bolts.
source_text:
You struggle with the computer for a while, but you cannot
# remove the chip. After a moment, you realize you forgot to remove
# the locking bolts.

text: 你费了好大劲摆弄计算机，但是仍没有取下净水芯片。过了一会，你才发现你没有把芯片边上固定用的卡子掰开。
source_text: 你费了好大劲摆弄计算机，但是仍没有取下净水芯片。过了一会，你才发现你没有把芯片边上固定用的卡子掰开。

text: You did not remove the chip. Perhaps you should try again,# this time a little more carefully.
source_text:
You did not remove the chip. Perhaps you should try again,
# this time a little more carefully.

text: 你没能取下净水芯片，或许你应该再更小心的试试。
source_text: 你没能取下净水芯片，或许你应该再更小心的试试。

text: You are too far away to carefully examine the water computer.
source_text: You are too far away to carefully examine the water computer.

text: 你观察水控制计算机时离的太远了，没能看仔细。
source_text: 你观察水控制计算机时离的太远了，没能看仔细。

text: You fail to repair the computer.
source_text: You fail to repair the computer.

text: 你修理电脑失败了。
source_text: 你修理电脑失败了。

text: You learn nothing special about the water computer.
source_text: You learn nothing special about the water computer.

text: 在控水计算机上你学不到任何特别的知识。
source_text: 在控水计算机上你学不到任何特别的知识。

text: You reinstall the water chip into the computer. The computer# reboots after a moment, and proceeds to function as normal.
source_text:
You reinstall the water chip into the computer. The computer
# reboots after a moment, and proceeds to function as normal.

text: 你把净水芯片重新安装在计算机上。过了一会计算机重新启动完毕，开始正常运转了。
source_text: 你把净水芯片重新安装在计算机上。过了一会计算机重新启动完毕，开始正常运转了。

text: This item cannot be used on the computer.
source_text: This item cannot be used on the computer.

text: 这个物品不能使用在计算机上面。
source_text: 这个物品不能使用在计算机上面。

text: You see a water processing control computer. It is functional.
source_text: You see a water processing control computer. It is functional.

text: 你看见一个水控制计算机，它运转的很正常。
source_text: 你看见一个水控制计算机，它运转的很正常。

text: You gain
source_text: You gain

text: experience points for getting a water chip.
source_text: experience points for getting a water chip.

text: You examine the computer carefully. Your analytical mind discovers# a couple of methods that will ease the removal of the water chip.
source_text:
You examine the computer carefully. Your analytical mind discovers
# a couple of methods that will ease the removal of the water chip.

text: 你仔细观察计算机。发现可以用两个办法轻易的取下净水芯片。
source_text: 你仔细观察计算机。发现可以用两个办法轻易的取下净水芯片。

text: You learn that there is no way to fix the computer without# reinstalling the water chip.
source_text:
You learn that there is no way to fix the computer without
# reinstalling the water chip.

text: 你意识到没有净水芯片就永远无法修理控水计算机。
source_text: 你意识到没有净水芯片就永远无法修理控水计算机。

text: After shutting down the Water Purification Computer, you can now# hear the repaired water pump working in the distance, bringing water up# from what must be a deep well under Necropolis.
source_text:
After shutting down the Water Purification Computer, you can now
# hear the repaired water pump working in the distance, bringing water up
# from what must be a deep well under Necropolis.

text: 关闭控水计算机后，你能听见修复后的水泵在很远的地方运转，水从大墓地以下很深的井里涌了出来。
source_text: 关闭控水计算机后，你能听见修复后的水泵在很远的地方运转，水从大墓地以下很深的井里涌了出来。
